in_sanskrit.name: धर्मानन्द
in_sanskrit.meaning: धर्म (dharma) वान् नन्दन (nandana) - Dharma (ethics, law, religion) and Nandana (delighting, pleasing)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who delights in righteousness and ethics

in_hindi.name: धर्मानन्द
in_hindi.meaning: धर्म (dharma) आनन्द (anand) - Dharma (duty, morality, righteousness) and Anand (joy, happiness)
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who finds joy in his duty, morality and righteousness

in_tamil.name: தர்மாநந்த
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who pleases with his dharma

in_telugu.name: ధర్మానంద
in_telugu.meaning: ధర్మ (dharma) నంద (nandam) - Dharma (duty, righteousness) and Nandam (pleasing)
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is pleasing through his duty and righteousness

in_marathi.name: Dharmanand
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Dharma (righteousness) and Anand (bliss)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharmanand हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dharmanand is a combination of two Sanskrit words, 'Dharma' and 'Anand'. Dharma refers to righteousness, truth, and moral duties. Anand signifies bliss, happiness, and joy. Together, this name represents a person who embodies righteousness and experiences immense happiness and joy in life.
